Definition: comparative of G1646; far less:--less than the least.
BiblicalUsage: elachistóteros is a plain word for less than the least. In Ephesians 3:8, the text says "who am less than the least of all saints."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, elachistóteros means less than the least, nothing more and nothing less.
